summary: Recorded explicit initial collection and analysis boundaries, projected proposal/review/application stages from persisted outcomes, and added accessible stage and flight-recorder views with honest query failure states.
model: New runs begin with stageHistory=[]; absent stageHistory remains legacy not recorded.
Collect spans initial workspace snapshot loading; Analyze spans runtime execution, including tools and proposal generation. Completion observations are appended only after those operations succeed.
Propose is grounded in persisted proposals. Interrupted runs label recorded proposals without claiming generation completed.
Review counts pending decisions, human decisions, granted autonomy and unknown legacy decision sources separately.
Apply completes only when every recorded proposal is applied; failed, rejected, pending, mixed and approved-without-application outcomes remain explicit.
Answer-only successful tracked runs mark proposal/review/application not needed. Failure and cancellation remain terminal and preserve any proposal outcomes.
invariants: No changes to approval token/snapshot checks or proposal mutations.
Lifecycle row updates append facts while preserving cancellation wins. Cancellation during collection prevents subsequent analysis.
No migration or legacy history backfill. Existing run/proposal routes retain workspace and capability gates.
Proposal review remains ahead of technical details and the flight recorder.
